en.flow: Leave a calm area beside the swimming run.
en.space: Leave an uninterrupted swim path for the adult group.
en.group: Keep at least 8 together; aim for 10 or more when space allows.
en.feeding: Offer small food that reaches midwater.
en.setup: Provide cover around open swimming space.

zh-CN.oxygen: 保持过滤水体溶氧充足。
zh-CN.flow: 游泳区旁留有平缓水流区域。
zh-CN.space: 为成鱼群体保留连续游泳空间。
zh-CN.group: 至少8尾同养；空间允许时以10尾或更多为宜。
zh-CN.feeding: 提供能到达中层的小颗粒食物。
zh-CN.setup: 在开阔游泳区周围提供遮蔽。

equipment_baseline: stable filtration and open swimming room

equipment_baseline_localized.en: stable filtration and open swimming room
equipment_baseline_localized.zh-CN: 稳定过滤并保留开阔游动空间

en.oxygen: Keep filtration and gas exchange steady.
en.flow: Use a gentle current with quiet planted areas.
en.space: Plan space for the adult shoal, despite their small size.
en.group: Keep at least 8 together; aim for 10 or more when space allows.
en.feeding: Use fine food that small mouths can take.
en.setup: Plant cover without filling the whole swim path.

zh-CN.oxygen: 保持稳定过滤和气体交换。
zh-CN.flow: 采用缓和水流，并留有安静的水草区。
zh-CN.space: 体型虽小，仍按成鱼群体规划空间。
zh-CN.group: 至少8尾同养；空间允许时以10尾或更多为宜。
zh-CN.feeding: 提供适合小口径的细小食物。
zh-CN.setup: 用水草遮蔽，但不要占满游泳空间。

equipment_baseline_localized.zh-CN: 缓和水流并提供水草遮蔽

en.oxygen: Keep normal filtration and gas exchange stable.
en.flow: Allow moderate flow with sheltered edges.
en.space: Reserve a clear swimming run for the adult group.
en.group: Keep at least 8 together; aim for 10 or more when space allows.
en.feeding: Offer appropriately sized food in midwater.
en.setup: Combine plant cover with open water.

zh-CN.oxygen: 保持稳定过滤和正常气体交换。
zh-CN.flow: 可有适中水流，边缘留遮蔽区。
zh-CN.space: 为成鱼群体留出开阔游泳区。
zh-CN.group: 至少8尾同养；空间允许时以10尾或更多为宜。
zh-CN.feeding: 在中层提供合适大小的食物。
zh-CN.setup: 水草遮蔽与开阔水域兼顾。

equipment_baseline_localized.zh-CN: 适中的水流和遮蔽空间

en.oxygen: Maintain good water quality and gas exchange even with gentle flow.
en.flow: Avoid a strong current at the surface.
en.space: Allow separate sheltered areas if keeping a pair.
en.group: One can be kept alone; pair only with room and a backup separation plan.
en.feeding: Offer small foods at the surface and in midwater.
en.setup: Provide surface cover without sealing off gas exchange.

zh-CN.oxygen: 即使水流缓和，也要保持良好水质与气体交换。
zh-CN.space: 成对饲养时提供各自可躲避的区域。
zh-CN.group: 可单养；成对需空间和必要时分开的预案。
zh-CN.feeding: 提供水面和中层可摄取的小型食物。
zh-CN.setup: 提供水面遮蔽，但不要妨碍气体交换。

text.en: A pair may not coexist peacefully; watch for chasing and separate if needed.
text.zh-CN: 成对个体未必能和平共处；留意追逐，必要时分开。

equipment_baseline_localized.zh-CN: 水面遮蔽并保持缓和水流

en.oxygen: Keep water well oxygenated; surface visits do not replace this.
en.flow: Use circulation that leaves resting spots on the bottom.
en.space: Prioritize usable bottom area for the group.
en.group: Keep at least 6 together; 8 or more is preferable when bottom space allows.
en.feeding: Deliver sinking food to the bottom; do not rely on leftovers.
en.setup: Use smooth substrate to protect foraging barbels.

zh-CN.oxygen: 保持水体溶氧充足；上浮换气不能替代这一点。
zh-CN.flow: 让水体循环，同时在底部留有休息区。
zh-CN.space: 优先保证群体可用的底面积。
zh-CN.group: 至少6尾同养；底部空间允许时以8尾或更多为宜。
zh-CN.feeding: 把沉底食物送到底层，不依赖其他鱼的剩食。
zh-CN.setup: 用圆润底材保护觅食时的触须。

text.en: Check that food reaches the bottom group before faster tank mates take it.
text.zh-CN: 确认食物到达底层鱼群，避免被动作较快的混养鱼先吃完。

equipment_baseline_localized.zh-CN: 圆润底材和含氧充足的水体

en.oxygen: Keep the established tank filtered and oxygenated.
en.flow: Gentle circulation lets shrimp graze without being swept away.
en.space: Usable surfaces and cover matter more than a guessed tank length.
en.group: Start a colony with about 10 when space and water quality allow.
en.feeding: Let them graze established biofilm and supplement sparingly.
en.setup: Provide dense cover, especially for young shrimp and molts.

zh-CN.oxygen: 成熟缸仍需过滤并保持充足溶氧。
zh-CN.flow: 缓和水流便于觅食，也避免把虾冲走。
zh-CN.space: 可攀附表面与遮蔽比推测缸长更重要。
zh-CN.group: 空间和水质允许时，可从约10只开始建立虾群。
zh-CN.feeding: 以成熟生物膜为食源之一，少量补充饲料。
zh-CN.setup: 提供密集遮蔽，尤其保护幼虾和蜕壳个体。

text.en: Many fish will eat young shrimp even when they leave adults alone.
text.zh-CN: 许多鱼即使不捕食成虾，也会捕食幼虾。

text.en: Guard the filter intake so young shrimp are not drawn in.
text.zh-CN: 给过滤进水口加防护，避免幼虾被吸入。

equipment_baseline_localized.zh-CN: 提供遮蔽并保持成熟的生物膜

en.oxygen: Maintain stable filtration and gas exchange.
en.flow: Leave calmer water for long-finned strains.
en.space: Plan for adult fish and possible offspring, not just the initial group.
en.group: A small loose group can start with about 3; plan for offspring if sexes are mixed.
en.feeding: Offer varied small foods that reach surface and midwater.
en.setup: Plant cover while retaining open swimming room.

zh-CN.oxygen: 保持稳定过滤和气体交换。
zh-CN.flow: 为长鳍品系留有较平缓的水域。
zh-CN.space: 按成鱼和可能的后代规划，而非只看初始数量。
zh-CN.group: 松散小群可从约3尾起养；混养雌雄需考虑后代。
zh-CN.feeding: 提供可到达水面和中层的多样小型食物。
zh-CN.setup: 有水草遮蔽，也要保留游泳空间。

text.en: Mixed-sex groups may produce young quickly; plan for their care and space.
text.zh-CN: 混养雌雄可能较快繁殖；需预先考虑幼鱼照料与空间。

en.oxygen: Air breathing does not make stagnant or poor-quality water safe.
en.flow: Use gentle filtered circulation, especially for long fins.
en.space: Provide accessible surface and places to rest.
en.group: Keep a single betta; do not infer pair housing from the count of one.
en.feeding: Offer suitable small foods near the surface without overfeeding.
en.setup: Use a secure lid and surface access, with cover for resting.

zh-CN.oxygen: 可呼吸空气也不代表停水或差水质安全。
zh-CN.flow: 保持缓和的过滤水流，长鳍品系尤其需要。
zh-CN.space: 保证能到达水面，并有休息位置。
zh-CN.group: 单养斗鱼；数量为一不意味着可以配对饲养。
zh-CN.feeding: 在水面附近提供适合的小型食物，避免过量。
zh-CN.setup: 缸盖牢固，保留上浮通道及休息遮蔽。

text.en: Do not house two males together; assess any tank mates individually.
text.zh-CN: 不要同缸饲养两条雄鱼；混养对象需逐一评估。

text.en: Some tank mates may nip long fins or be attacked by the betta.
text.zh-CN: 某些混养鱼可能啄咬长鳍，或受到斗鱼攻击。

text.en: Betta can jump; keep a secure lid with access to air at the surface.
text.zh-CN: 斗鱼可能跳缸；固定缸盖，并保留水面呼吸空间。

equipment_baseline: Heater, gentle filtration and secure lid

equipment_baseline_localized.en: Heater, gentle filtration and secure lid
equipment_baseline_localized.zh-CN: 加热、缓流过滤和牢固缸盖

en.oxygen: Provide well-oxygenated water independently of current strength.
en.flow: Moderate circulation suits active swimming; retain a calmer resting area.
en.space: Aim for about 60 cm of continuous swimming length and a secure lid.
en.group: Keep at least 6 together, with enough swimming space for the group.
en.feeding: Offer suitably sized food at the surface and in midwater.
en.setup: Keep a clear swim path and cover the tank to limit jumping.

zh-CN.oxygen: 无论水流强弱，都要保持较高溶氧。
zh-CN.flow: 适中水流便于活跃游动，也留一处平缓休息区。
zh-CN.space: 争取约60厘米连续游泳长度，并加牢固缸盖。
zh-CN.group: 至少6尾同养，并为群体保留足够游泳空间。
zh-CN.feeding: 在水面和中层提供大小合适的食物。
zh-CN.setup: 保留连续游泳空间，盖好缸盖防跳。

text.en: Active swimmers may jump; keep the lid secure.
text.zh-CN: 活跃游泳时可能跳缸；请固定缸盖。

equipment_baseline: Long swimming space, oxygenation and secure lid

equipment_baseline_localized.en: Long swimming space, oxygenation and secure lid
equipment_baseline_localized.zh-CN: 较长游泳空间、充足溶氧和缸盖

en.oxygen: Keep filtration and gas exchange adequate for this larger fish.
en.flow: Provide circulation without removing sheltered resting places.
en.space: Prioritize adult bottom area and a retreat; tank length is unconfirmed.
en.group: House singly unless individual compatibility and space are assessed.
en.feeding: Supply sinking vegetable-based foods; algae alone is insufficient.
en.setup: Provide wood and a suitable hiding place.

zh-CN.oxygen: 为这种体型较大的鱼维持足够过滤和气体交换。
zh-CN.flow: 保证水体循环，同时留有遮蔽休息处。
zh-CN.space: 优先考虑成鱼底面积与躲避处；缸长尚未确认。
zh-CN.group: 默认单养；增加个体前需评估个体相容性和空间。
zh-CN.feeding: 提供沉底植物性食物，不能只靠缸壁藻类。
zh-CN.setup: 提供沉木和合适的躲避处。

text.en: Individuals can dispute shelters and bottom territory, especially with limited space.
text.zh-CN: 个体可能争夺躲避处和底部领地，空间不足时尤需注意。

equipment_baseline: Bottom area, hiding places, wood and adequate filtration

equipment_baseline_localized.en: Bottom area, hiding places, wood and adequate filtration
equipment_baseline_localized.zh-CN: 底部空间、躲避处、沉木和足够过滤
